about_the_game:
ABOUT THIS DEMO

In this demo you will meet the Cat King's closest friends and main characters while investigating the mysterious activities of the dogs. You will be able to purchase certain items from Sakura's shop, do three side quests from the Shopping Mall, save one of Kenix's classmates and help Eren Chan the local idol in her club. You will engage in battle against some dogs, meet Kenix at school, save the Mayor, Kenix's classmate and in the end meet Azumi the Cat Witch who has worry dog news for you! 

Note

  • This demo is limited to just the story and world introduction missions stated above

  • After completing the main storyline you are able to continue exploring the world and take on side missions

  • Some features may differ from the final game

About the Final Product

Immerse yourself in the funny world of the Cat King and his friends on a mission to stop their hometown being changed into DOGVILLE! Enjoy the many funny and cute characters, exciting music from Eren Chan, team up with characters of different abilities, build up your own and your characters equipment and abilities, make decisions on how to approach different battles and problems selecting the right team, explore an open world full of strange and funny characters. Experience the whackiest cat adventure ever!

short_description: The game is a story rich, open world, action RPG. It is a top down view game where players may develop and team up with other cats as well as themselves. Players are free to choose their approach, enjoy funny dialogues with step by step guides to quests.
